title: Teach someone your favourite knot
description: Anywhere, anytime. Takes four minutes. They will use it all week.

title: Bring water to someone building in the sun
description: Look for the people still hauling at 2pm. They have forgotten to drink.

title: Sit with a stranger for ten minutes and say nothing
description: Agree to it out loud first. Then just sit. It is harder and better than it sounds.

title: Find whoever made your favourite thing here and tell them
description: Someone spent months on the thing you walked past. Go back. Say so.

title: Carry something heavy for a camp that isn't yours
description: No need to ask what it's for. Just take one end.

title: Leave a written note where it will be found tomorrow
description: Not signed. Not clever. Just kind.

title: Cook for someone who forgot to eat
description: There is always at least one. Usually they are the one cooking for everyone else.

title: Learn one song well enough to sing it at 3am
description: You will need it. Someone will need it.

title: MOOP sweep a plaza at sunrise
description: One person, one plaza, one hour, before anyone is awake to see you do it.

title: Give away the thing you're most attached to
description: Not the spare one. The one you'd rather keep.

title: Ask three people what they're afraid of
description: Answer first, honestly, or it doesn't count.

title: Repair something broken that isn't yours
description: Gaffer tape counts. Doing it without being asked is the point.

title: Walk someone home who is lost
description: All the way. Not just pointing.

title: Hold space at Sanctuary for an hour
description: Only if you are steady today. Check in with the crew there first.

title: Photograph nothing for a whole day
description: Describe one thing out loud to someone instead. See which one you remember in a year.

title: Make a stranger laugh before breakfast
description: Low bar. Early hours. Surprisingly difficult.

title: Take a shift nobody signed up for
description: Check the boards for the gaps. The 4am ones. Those.

title: Introduce two people who should know each other
description: Say why, out loud, to both of them. Then leave.

title: Thank whoever is still playing at 5am
description: When the floor is nearly empty is exactly when it matters.

title: Wash dishes for a camp that fed you
description: Don't ask. Just start.

title: Get up for sunrise once
description: Once. That's the whole mission.

title: Ask someone to teach you the thing they're best at
description: Everyone here is unreasonably good at something. Find out what.

title: Sit somewhere dark and listen for ten minutes
description: No phone. Away from the sound systems. You will hear the whole place breathing.

title: Write down one thing you're taking home
description: Then give the note to whoever caused it.
